adoption_state.note: Adoption is established from the authenticated S02 v2 checkpoint: variant C, abstention_first_candidates_only, with the adopted candidate-layer construct set. Adoption is a state of its own and is not execution: execution_state records that nothing ran, zero candidates were emitted and zero conflicts were found. The outcome table below is a specification, not the adoption instrument. Reading adoption as execution, or execution as adoption, is refused by name.

execution_state.note: Nothing has been executed: executed is false, candidates_emitted is zero and conflicts is zero. The adopted construct set is non-empty, so emission is permitted in principle, but no candidate is minted and no Conflict is reachable until execution actually establishes proven source spans. Adoption alone yields Unknown for every input.

construct_dictionary.note: The eight families are not redeclared here: this contract references the S01 register for their identity, their fail-closed boundaries and their vocabulary status. Adopting the candidate layer promotes no family: promoted_statuses is empty, adoption_does_not_promote_families is true and every status stays exactly what the S01 register records.

candidate_envelope.envelope_role: design-only shape of an emission decision; no record is committed and no record may be committed while execution_state.executed is false

verdict.note: Only the candidate_emitted verdict corresponds to a minted candidate record, and only after execution. Unknown and Conflict are distinct non-emission outcomes: they must never be materialized as candidates and must never be read as one another.

non_claims: The envelope is a declared shape, not a runtime object, and minted_field_count is zero.
A source anchor must name a repository-relative tracked path and a sha256, or the explicit unresolved marker; an anchor without either is not an anchor.
An envelope without an adopted_construct_ref is not a candidate.
An evidence_class outside the closed dictionary is not admissible.
A candidate requires an executed adopted construct; adoption alone never mints one.

outcomes.predicate: the adopted_construct_ref is in the adopted_construct_set and the construct was actually executed: at least one proven source span establishes the family in execution and the anchors agree
no proven source span has been established in execution for the family, because execution was not performed or no span was proven; absence of a proven source span is never falsity
at least two anchors of an adopted construct diverge in execution; Conflict requires execution and is unreachable without it, and is never a majority pick nor a silent preference

outcome_dictionary.rejected_single_outcome: There is no collapse outcome and no merged outcome: Unknown and Conflict are separate outcomes with separate codes and separate predicates, and neither is candidate_emitted.

emission_rule.note: The emission rule separates adoption from execution. Adoption is established, yet execution has not run: candidate_emitted and Conflict both require an executed construct, so in the committed state no candidate is emitted, Conflict stays unreachable and every outcome is Unknown. Execution without adoption is likewise Unknown, never an adoption.

boundaries.note: Classification is not composition: no composed rule, no precedence resolution, no facet default and no applicability evaluation is performed or promised. The six section 3 terms stay deferred-undefined, F13 is a separate decision with its own adoption, and Applicable, RuVector and TEI are not claimed.

consumes.role: start gate: admission_granted for the adopted candidate layer of variant C, the six-construct adopted_construct_set and execution_state not-executed bind this contract to the granted contour
admission source: the authenticated v2 checkpoint carries exactly one admission granted verdict line scoped to variant C, so the adoption is established while execution stays separate
closed eight-family dictionary, per-family fail-closed boundaries, vocabulary statuses and the closed evidence-class dictionary
variant C abstention_first_candidates_only: representation shape, consequences_for_S03, collapse risks, provenance_cardinality and the empty required_new_adr_terms list

non_claims: This contract is design-only: it mints no candidate, no normative IR, no rule graph and no crate surface, and it commits no record.
It is not an adoption of normative semantics: the adopted candidate layer is not a promotion of the eight families, normative_semantics_adopted is false and section 3 stays deferred-undefined.
Adoption is not execution: adoption is established from the authenticated S02 v2 grant, yet execution_state.executed is false, zero candidates were emitted and no Conflict was observed.
Execution is not adoption: a run that produced no authenticated adoption never becomes an adoption, and no candidate is emitted from execution alone.
Unknown is not Conflict and neither is a negative finding: absence of a proven source span is never falsity, and a Conflict is never a majority pick.
Classification is not composition: no composed rule, no precedence, no facet default and no applicability evaluation is performed or promised.
NormRule, Condition, LegalEffect, Exception, Defeater and ApplicabilitySelector stay deferred-undefined; section 3 is not edited and no term is promoted.
F13 is a separate decision with its own adoption and is never derived from the bounded IR.
Out-of-scope surfaces stay untouched: Applicable, RuVector, TEI and the F13 operation grammar are not claimed.
No candidate is emitted and Conflict is unreachable while execution_state.executed is false, even though the adopted construct set is non-empty.
revision_policy: Re-derive before use: re-hash every consumed path, re-read the S01 register family statuses and the closed evidence-class dictionary, and re-read the admission from the live S03 start gate and the authenticated S02 v2 checkpoint before showing this contract; no timestamp and no aggregate engine hash are stored here.
